title: School Play
hook: 幼儿园排《小红帽》，大灰狼是丹尼狗演的，演到一半他忘了词，猎人又太害羞。

cells.q: What is the playgroup going to do?
cells.a: They are going to put on a play for everyone.
cells.cn: 他们要为所有人演一出话剧。

cells.q: Who is the Big Bad Wolf?
cells.a: Danny Dog is going to play the Big Bad Wolf.

cells.q: What did they say about Danny's wolf?
cells.a: They said it was really scary, and he can be scarier.
cells.cn: 他们说他演得真吓人，还可以更凶一点。

cells.a: Pedro is a bit shy when he says his lines.
cells.cn: 佩德罗说台词的时候有点害羞。

cells.q: Who came to see the play?
cells.a: All the parents have come to see the school play.
cells.cn: 所有家长都来看这出话剧。

cells.a: Grandma is at home, and a visitor comes to the door.
cells.cn: 奶奶在家，这时门口来了一个客人。

cells.q: What did Little Red Riding Hood say?
cells.a: She said, “You don't look like my grandma.”
cells.cn: 她说：“你一点也不像我奶奶。”

cells.q: Who comes in to help at the end?
cells.a: Pedro the hunter comes in to save Little Red Riding Hood.
cells.cn: 猎人佩德罗上场救了小红帽。

cells.q: What did the hunter say to the wolf?
cells.a: He said, “You are a very naughty wolf.”
cells.cn: 他对狼说：“你是一头很调皮的狼。”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: play, wolf, hunter, grandma, shy, scary
helper.actions: practise, act, forget, shout, come in, clap

ending: In the end, the play goes well and everyone claps. My favourite part is ______.
